tools.name: kbo_company_search
tools.description: VAT status / does this company exist: look up one EU VAT or enterprise number in EU VIES (Belgian KBO/BCE included). Returns registered name, VAT id, address and status; not proof of every company without VAT registration. 2 credits (EUR 0.02) per successful call; needs a bearer token.

tools.name: review_invoice
tools.description: Check a structured invoice: Peppol fields, totals, EU VIES VAT, fixes and UBL XML. Never sends; unanswered VAT is unknown. No receiver lookup here. tools.name: verify_iban
tools.description: Check an IBAN's structure and check digits for 70+ countries, offline. It never claims the account exists or who owns it. Free, no token.

tools.name: check_peppol_ready
tools.description: Check your own invoice against 21 published Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 rules, and whether the customer's Peppol address is registered; each finding names the rule and the fix. A listed subset, not the official validator. Free, no token.

tools.name: lookup_peppol_participant
tools.description: Ask live Peppol registers about e-invoice reception, document types and failure contacts; never guarantees delivery. Not a VAT or company-register check; use kbo_company_search (one company) or check_vat_list (a list). Free, no token.

tools.name: check_payment_change
tools.description: Check a supplier's bank-detail change before the vendor record is touched: returns no_change, verify_first, stop or invalid_new_account with call-back steps. It never says an account is safe. Free, no token.

tools.name: preflight_payment
tools.description: For a structured invoice, call review_invoice first. Before paying, compare the supplied human approval with the payment and run rail checks (invoice: IBAN, account change).
